Hanno Riverbed Operations Notice Due to Typhoon

Due to an approaching typhoon, operations at Hanno Riverbed will be as follows:

• June 27 (Saturday) – CLOSED
• June 28 (Sunday) – Decision will be made based on river water level conditions

Operations updates will be posted on the official X (Twitter) account "Hanno Riverbed. Ii-Shiome." (飯能河原。いい塩梅。)

Please do not go to the riverbed to check water conditions yourself – this is dangerous.

For more information: Oku-Musashi Hanno Tourism Association (奥むさし飯能観光協会)
